use: AI visual review for ambiguity identification; not automatic training labels or an official score
method: Viewed five overview sheets and explicitly listed original frame JPGs. No model inference. Null means not established by this review. Search intervals are coarse inspection windows, not certified ground-truth bounds.

reviews.counterparty: Dark hatchback/wagon crossing from the right-side junction in front of the dashcam; distinct from the light hatchback overtaken earlier.
reviews.entry_evidence: The dark vehicle is crossing from the right by frames 20-28. Exact entry into the ego lane cannot be fixed because lane paint is indistinct and the dashcam path changes around the light hatchback.
reviews.evasion_evidence: Roadway to the left of the crossing vehicle is visibly open in the near-conflict overview frames. The right side is bounded by the crossing vehicle and roadside curb. This is a visible-space judgment, not proof that a safe maneuver remained dynamically feasible.
limitations: Collision timing was not independently annotated frame by frame

reviews.counterparty: Orange dump truck ahead, which turns across the roadway later; distinct from the gray truck on the near right at the beginning.
reviews.entry_evidence: The orange truck is already ahead in the dashcam's lane at frame 0. Its later turn is not its initial entry. This annotation is conditional on the orange truck being the intended counterparty.
reviews.entry_side_evidence: The route by which this already-leading truck entered before the clip is not shown; its subsequent left turn does not establish that prior entry side.
reviews.evasion_evidence: Frame 40 and the overview show broad unobstructed road/shoulder space to the right of the turning truck, while oncoming traffic occupies the left.
limitations: The interaction with the oncoming light vehicle is visible; the exact dashcam contact/counterparty pairing is not independently established from this sparse review

reviews.counterparty: Silver/gray compact MPV moving diagonally out from the parked/right-side vehicles toward the dashcam path; distinct from the light oncoming sedan on the left.
reviews.entry_evidence: The MPV advances from the right through frames 16-28. The road has no clear lane markings and the ego path shifts left; a precise ego-lane crossing frame cannot be determined.
reviews.evasion_evidence: After the oncoming light sedan passes on the left, substantial open paved space remains to the left/front of the MPV around frame 28. The overview also shows the ego view moving into that space. Safe timing and vehicle-clearance margins are not measured.
limitations: Search interval is not an exact entry label

reviews.counterparty: White hatchback directly ahead throughout the clip.
reviews.entry_evidence: The white hatchback is directly ahead in the same narrow road corridor at frame 0 and remains there until the dashcam closes the gap. No later lateral entry is visible.
reviews.entry_side_evidence: No pre-clip lateral entry trajectory is available.
reviews.evasion_evidence: No adjacent moving car is visible, but the road is narrow and bordered by grass/verges. The viewed frames do not establish whether a full vehicle-width usable escape space exists at contact; absence of traffic alone is insufficient.
limitations: Usable lateral clearance cannot be established

reviews.counterparty: Dark blue compact MPV ahead that becomes immediately adjacent to the dashcam's right/front later; distinct from the green sedan initially alongside on the right and the red car farther right.
reviews.entry_evidence: The blue vehicle is already visible ahead at frame 0 and remains near the projected ego path at frames 16-20. However, unclear lane paint and the curving barrier prevent a firm distinction between already occupying the same lane and approaching from the adjacent lane. Frame 0 is a candidate, not a confirmed annotation.
reviews.entry_side_evidence: Later right-side proximity does not by itself establish the initial lane-entry side when the ego car also moves relative to the blue vehicle.
reviews.evasion_evidence: Near the conflict, the concrete divider/snow verge limits the left while the blue MPV occupies the immediate right/front and another car is farther right. No clear usable lateral gap is visible in the overview. Exact physical widths are not measured.
limitations: Do not force an exact entry frame or side from screen coordinates alone
